source: curated baseline authored for Leaderboard Wordle (private friend-group moderation, V1)
notes: Detection rule: `moderationKeyForDisplayName` (lowercase → leet/confusable map → strip separators and duplicate runs) then literal substring containment against the key forms below. Evasion variants (f.u.c.k via separators, f4ck, fuuck, a55hole, sh1thead) are caught by the key transform + the embedded variant entries (fuk, fuq, fck, fack, phuck, kunt). PER-DATASET RULE (decision log, Phase-2 planning v23): entries whose moderation key is a common substring of common benign vocabulary are EXCLUDED below rather than weakening the detector — their evasions pass deliberately and are documented residual (e.g. a55, sh1t, c0m, b0b, sp1c, m1ck, j4p, p4k, j3w, h0e, s3x, an4l, t1t). Residual collisions accepted: rape/grape, fuck-key/fukushima, cunt/scunthorpe, nigger-key/niger, dick/Dick, bitch-key/bichon, boobs/bobsleigh. The benign-name acceptance set in tests/unit/display-name.test.ts is the acceptance gate for this dataset.
